query: For the paper "Query-bag Matching with Mutual Coverage for Information-seeking Conversations in E-commerce" (arXiv: 1911.02747), answer this question: What datasets are used for experiments?
context:
[1] Source: 1911.02747.pdf | Page: 3 | Section: None
Title: Query-bag Matching with Mutual Coverage for Information-seeking Conversations in E-commerce
3 EXPERIMENTS 3.1 Dataset We conduct experiments on two datasets: AliMe and Quora. The Al- iMe dataset is collected from the AliMe intelligent assistant system and the Quora dataset is composed of a public dataset. AliMe For the AliMe service in E-commerce, we collect 8,004 query-bag pairs to form our dataset. Negative sampling is also an important part of the matching model. For each query, we use the Lucene2 to retrieval the top-20 most similar questions from the whole question candidates.

[2] Source: 1911.02747.pdf | Page: 2 | Section: None
Title: Query-bag Matching with Mutual Coverage for Information-seeking Conversations in E-commerce
In addition to the mutual coverage, a bag representa- tion in word level is issued to help discover the main points of a bag. The bag representation then provides new matching evidence to the query-bag matching model. We conduct experiments on the AliMe and Quora dataset for the query-bag matching based information-seeking conversation. Compared with baselines, we verify the effectiveness of our model.

Title: Query-bag Matching with Mutual Coverage for Information-seeking Conversations in E-commerce

[4] Source: 1911.02747.pdf | Page: 2 | Section: None
Title: Query-bag Matching with Mutual Coverage for Information-seeking Conversations in E-commerce
The ablation study shows the usefulness of the components. The contributions in this paper are summarized as follows: 1) To the best of our knowledge, we are the first to adopt query-bag matching in the information-seeking conversation. 2) We propose the mutual coverage model to measure the information coverage in the query-bag matching. 3) We release the composite Quora dataset to facilitate the research in this area.

[5] Source: 1911.02747.pdf | Page: 1 | Section: None
Title: Query-bag Matching with Mutual Coverage for Information-seeking Conversations in E-commerce
Inspired by such opinion, we propose a query-bag matching model which mainly utilizes the mutual coverage between query and bag and measures the degree of the content in the query mentioned by the bag, and vice verse. In addition, the learned bag representation in word level helps find the main points of a bag in a fine grade and promotes the query-bag matching performance. Experiments on two datasets show the effectiveness of our model.

[6] Source: 1911.02747.pdf | Page: 3 | Section: None
Title: Query-bag Matching with Mutual Coverage for Information-seeking Conversations in E-commerce
Query-bag Matching To verify the effectiveness of our pro- posed models, We design a new query-bag matching based baseline. We concatenate the questions in the bag to form a new long “ques- tion”, then the hCNN model is applied to measure the matching 3https://data.quora.com/First-Quora-Dataset-Release-Question-Pairs 4The composed Quora dataset and more detailed experiments are in https://github.

[7] Source: 1911.02747.pdf | Page: 4 | Section: None
Title: Query-bag Matching with Mutual Coverage for Information-seeking Conversations in E-commerce
5 CONCLUSION In this paper, we propose the QBM model which performs the query- bag matching in information-seeking conversation. Experiments show that the proposed mutual coverage component improves the model performance. And the model can automatically discover im- portant words in the query or bag from both the coverage weighting component and the word-level bag representation.

[8] Source: 1911.02747.pdf | Page: 3 | Section: None
Title: Query-bag Matching with Mutual Coverage for Information-seeking Conversations in E-commerce
An hCNN model is applied to train the new dataset. In the testing stage, each query- question pair is assigned with a probability indicating the matching degree. To compare with our model, we rank the bags based on the query-bag matching scores and the scores are defined as the max or mean matching probability of the query-question pairs in the query-bag pair. We name the two instances Q-Q Max and Q-Q Mean respectively.

[9] Source: 1911.02747.pdf | Page: 2 | Section: None
Title: Query-bag Matching with Mutual Coverage for Information-seeking Conversations in E-commerce
hCNN is a CNN based matching model which is fast enough to work on the industry application. The input of hCNN is a query q and the i-th question bi in the bag. q and bi are fed into a CNN respectively. A cross-attention matrix Mi is fed into another CNN to get the interaction representation between them. Each element of Mi is defined as Mi a,b = q⊤a · bi,b where qa is the word embedding of the a-th word in query q and bi,b is the embedding of the b-th word in bi.

[10] Source: 1911.02747.pdf | Page: 2 | Section: None
Title: Query-bag Matching with Mutual Coverage for Information-seeking Conversations in E-commerce
In this paper, we propose a simple but effective mutual coverage component to model the above-mentioned problem. The coverage is based on the cross-attention matrix of the query-bag pair which in- dicates the matching degree of elements between the query and bag. The mutual coverage is performed by stacking the cross-attention matrix along two directions, i.e., query and bag, in the word level respectively.

[11] Source: 1911.02747.pdf | Page: 2 | Section: None
Title: Query-bag Matching with Mutual Coverage for Information-seeking Conversations in E-commerce
Our model obtains 0.05 and 0.03 R10@1 gains comparing to the strongest baseline in the two datasets.

[12] Source: 1911.02747.pdf | Page: 3 | Section: None
Title: Query-bag Matching with Mutual Coverage for Information-seeking Conversations in E-commerce
Q-Q Matching One starting point behind our work is that the query-bag matching may work better than the Q-Q matching for the information-seeking conversation. To verify such opinion, we propose the Q-Q matching based baseline and compare our model with two instances of the baseline. We extract the query-question pairs form the query-bag pair. The label of the query-bag pair is assigned to the new query-question pairs.

answer: 论文实验使用了两个数据集：AliMe 和 Quora [1]。AliMe 数据集收集自 AliMe 智能助手系统，包含 8,004 个 query-bag 对；Quora 数据集由公开数据集组成 [1]，且作者发布了组合（composite）的 Quora 数据集 [4]。

question.reason: 需求已由实验章节的数据集说明完全支持。
